title: 15 Best Santorini Wedding Venues With Caldera Views
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW venue guide (not a refresh). Model: content/posts/mykonos-wedding-venues and content/posts/corfu-wedding-venues (title with a sea-view promise). INCLUSION RULE (two parts): a live read of the venue's OWN official site says it hosts weddings AND its own site states a caldera view (for the property or its wedding spaces) in words. Never snippets alone, never from photos. If fewer than 15 qualify, the title count changes and the person is told; no padding. Hold back non-luxury venues as reserves.
TITLE: kept as given ('15 Best'), but the copy makes no 'best' ranking claims and does not rank venues; the list is grouped by area.

OVERLAP: the live old page /7-must-see-santorini-destination-wedding-venues targets the same keyword (ranks about #90 to #97 AU and falling). Recommend a 301 from the old page to this URL at publish (person's call). The Santorini planning guide draft (/destination-weddings/santorini-wedding) links the old page once in Step 3; that link should point here instead: noted in the run report only (the person is editing their copy; do not change other drafts). /venue/rocabella-santorini-hotel-spa NOT linked (its domain is for sale). SEO checks rankings for santorini wedding venues and variants (caldera wedding venues santorini, oia wedding venues, imerovigli wedding venue, santorini wedding venue small, santorini winery wedding).

Areas: Oia; Imerovigli and Firostefani; Fira; Pyrgos, Megalochori and the inland villages; Akrotiri and the south caldera. Each entry: area and setting, the caldera view as the venue states it, ceremony options as stated, capacity, rooms and exclusive use where published (else 'Not published'), one standout. One Advisor line in the whole body (comparison section) plus the close.

Supporting sections (short, reuse today's live-read facts from content/posts/santorini-wedding/03-source-pack.json): at-a-glance table (5 columns, mobile-friendly); how to compare like for like; choosing an area; getting there (airport, Visit Greece flight time, Smartraveller ferry advice; no port claims; no transfer arrangements); when to marry (HNMS Naxos, labelled as the nearest official station; Smartraveller heat, wildfire, earthquakes and volcanic activity); legal in brief (Smartraveller and Embassy Athens as at November 2026; 'check with the Municipality of Thira and the embassy, including any fees'; link /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding for the full steps).

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk ('on its own site', 'in its own words', 'does not publish' as our search, page dates as source talk, myths); 'often told' at most once; no hedge stacking; link each source once; no 'best' ranking claims; no best month.
Sources: venues' official sites only for venue facts; official sources for practical facts. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking or review sites, Wikipedia.

Links: /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding (draft, prominent, for planning steps), /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues, /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages, /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues, /destination-weddings/paros-wedding-venues (drafts), /destinations/europe/greece, /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions (once), /wonderland-concierge, /magazine. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=santorini-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing. Anchor text names 'Wedded Concierge', never 'Wonderland Concierge'.

Speed: Apify web-fetch. 4 parallel venue batches (A Oia fact_01+; B Imerovigli and Firostefani fact_100+; C Fira, inland villages and Akrotiri fact_200+; D discovery of further candidates island-wide fact_300+), 15 min HARD, reads in one or two parallel rounds, scratch folders sv_a..sv_d; practical and legal facts copied from the Santorini planning guide pack as part-5 (fact_500+); top-up sv_e (fact_400+) only if fewer than 15 qualify; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; venue images licensed or press kit with permission; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
